name: Ichinomiya (Yamanashi, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ichinomiya town emblem in white: a stylised device of two pointed ears above a ring with a small pointed device.
history: Flag of the former town of Ichinomiya in Yamanashi Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-10-12.

features.role: Ichinomiya town emblem — a stylised device of two pointed ears above a ring with a small pointed device
